Glass Card

Cards can contain icons, headings, body text, and optional CTAs or badges.

With Badge

A badge can appear at the top-right of a card to highlight status or a tag.

Plain Card

Uses the base `.card` class — white background, subtle border, soft shadow. Lifts on hover.

Plain Card

Features with img

Each accounting module shown with its graphic and description.

Sales

Create professional quotes and invoices in seconds, manage your customer relationships, and get a live view of your revenue pipeline — all from one place.

  • Invoices
  • Estimates
  • CRM

Purchases

Manage supplier bills, vendor accounts, and contractor payments with ease. Keep your payables under control and never miss a due date.

  • Bills
  • Vendors
  • Contractors

Payroll

Run payroll in a few clicks. Automate pay runs, handle statutory remittances, and keep schedules and reporting audit-ready at all times.

  • Payroll Run
  • Remittance
  • Schedules
  • Reporting

Banking

Connect your bank accounts and import transactions automatically. Set smart rules and reconcile your books in minutes, not hours.

  • Feeds
  • Rules
  • Reconcile

Inventory

Raise purchase orders, manage your item catalogue, and track stock levels in real time. Never run out of stock or over-order again.

  • Purchase Orders
  • Items Management

Project Management

Win more work with detailed bids, track project progress against budget, and invoice clients as milestones are reached — keeping every project profitable.

  • Bids
  • Project Tracking
  • Progress Invoicing

Reporting

Turn raw numbers into clear insights. Generate financial statements, sales tax returns, and AR/AP summaries in real time — and export to PDF or Excel with a single click.

  • Financial Statements
  • Sales Tax
  • AR / AP
